products.name: Last-Mile Delivery Services
products.description: Physical transportation and delivery of packages from distribution hubs to recipients’ doorsteps within a designated service area, using a company-owned fleet and employed drivers. Service includes package pickup, route optimization, real-time tracking, and delivery confirmation, primarily for business and residential customers.

products.name: Route X Delivery Platform
products.description: A digital platform (mobile application) connecting third-party drivers with merchants seeking route delivery services. The app facilitates matching, scheduling, and transaction management for delivery opportunities, generating revenue by enabling these connections. Currently in development and testing phase.

products.name: Real Estate Investment Management
products.description: Management of global real estate investment funds and vehicles, including opportunistic, Core+, and debt strategies, delivered through private funds, REITs, and other vehicles to institutional and individual investors. Involves physical asset acquisition, management, and lending secured by real estate.

products.name: Private Equity Investment Management
products.description: Management of private equity funds and strategies investing in companies across industries and geographies, including corporate private equity, tactical opportunities, life sciences, and growth equity, delivered via private funds and vehicles to institutional and individual investors. Involves capital deployment, operational support, and value creation in portfolio companies.

products.name: Infrastructure Investment Management
products.description: Management of infrastructure-focused funds and vehicles investing in large-scale assets such as energy, transportation, digital infrastructure, and water/waste, delivered to institutional and individual investors. Involves long-term ownership and operational management of physical infrastructure assets.

products.name: Credit Investment Management
products.description: Management of credit-focused funds and vehicles, including private corporate credit, liquid corporate credit, and asset-based credit strategies, delivered through funds, CLOs, BDCs, and SMAs to institutional and individual investors. Involves lending, investing in debt securities, and managing credit portfolios.

products.name: Insurance Asset Management Services
products.description: Provision of investment management services for insurance and reinsurance accounts, constructing customized, diversified portfolios primarily of investment grade credit, delivered through SMAs and insurance-dedicated funds. Involves portfolio construction, asset allocation, and risk management for insurance clients.

products.name: Secondary Market Solutions
products.description: Acquisition and management of secondary interests in private funds and alternative asset managers, providing liquidity solutions to original holders and investment opportunities to new investors. Delivered through dedicated secondary funds and advisory services.

products.name: Multi-Asset and Hedge Fund Solutions
products.description: Management of multi-asset and hedge fund portfolios, including absolute return, multi-strategy, and total portfolio management, delivered through commingled funds, SMAs, and customized portfolios to institutional and individual investors. Involves allocation across asset classes and public/private markets.

products.name: Capital Markets Services
products.description: Provision of capital markets advisory and execution services, including acquisition, origination, and transaction support for portfolio companies and funds. Delivered through a registered broker-dealer subsidiary.

products.name: Food Safety Diagnostic Test Kits
products.description: Manufactured consumable test kits and complementary products (e.g., culture media) for detecting foodborne pathogens, spoilage organisms, natural toxins, allergens, and nutritional components in food and animal feed. Delivered as single-use kits using proprietary antibodies and nucleic acid detection, often read by automated instruments.

products.name: Food Safety Software and Data Services
products.description: Advanced software systems and SaaS platforms for environmental monitoring, risk management, and workflow automation in food safety testing. Delivered digitally and integrated with diagnostic instruments for data aggregation, analysis, and compliance support.

products.name: Food Safety Laboratory Testing Services
products.description: ISO-accredited laboratory services providing fee-for-service food safety analysis and testing for the food and feed industries. Delivered through in-house labs using proprietary and validated methods.

products.name: Specialty Enzymes and Diagnostic Reagents for Food and Beverage Quality Control
products.description: Manufactured diagnostic kits, specialty enzymes, and reagents for quality control laboratories in the food, animal feed, and beverage industries. Delivered as validated assays for measuring dietary fibers, carbohydrates, sugars, and organic acids.

products.name: Veterinary Instruments and Disposables
products.description: Manufactured and distributed veterinary instruments and delivery systems for administering antibiotics, vaccines, and other treatments. Includes needles, syringes, and precision devices for injections, oral/topical administration, and animal identification. Delivered as physical products to veterinarians and livestock producers.

products.name: Veterinary Pharmaceuticals and Vaccines
products.description: Manufactured pharmaceuticals, antibiotics, and USDA/FDA-approved vaccines for animal health, including treatments for infections, deficiencies, and disease prevention. Delivered as regulated, packaged drugs and vaccines to veterinarians and animal producers.

products.name: Animal Care Products and Nutritional Supplements
products.description: Manufactured animal care solutions including digestive aids, nutritional supplements, and topical treatments for livestock and companion animals. Delivered as consumable products through veterinary and retail channels.

products.name: Rodent and Insect Control Products
products.description: Manufactured rodent control baits and insecticides for agricultural, professional, and retail markets. Includes products with various active ingredients and proprietary formulations, delivered as physical baits and sprays for biosecurity and pest management.

products.name: Cleaners and Disinfectants for Animal and Food Production
products.description: Manufactured and distributed cleaners and disinfectants for hygiene and disease prevention in animal production and food processing environments. Delivered as chemical products for facility sanitation.

products.name: Genomics Testing and Bioinformatics Services for Animals
products.description: DNA genotyping, sequencing, and trait analysis services for livestock and companion animals, including bioinformatics support for genetic improvement. Delivered through global genomics laboratories and digital data platforms.

products.name: Life Science and Toxicology Reagents and Test Kits
products.description: Manufactured reagents and test kits for immunoassay production, forensic and animal toxicology, and life science research. Delivered as consumable kits and substrates for research and diagnostic labs.

products.name: Online Capital Raising Platform (Funding Portal)
products.description: A web-based platform that enables private companies to raise capital online from accredited and non-accredited investors under Regulation Crowdfunding (Reg CF), providing automated onboarding, regulatory filings, compliance review, and investor access. The platform is operated digitally and is regulated by the SEC and FINRA.

products.name: Broker-Dealer Services for Regulation A and D Offerings
products.description: Broker-dealer services for hosting and facilitating Regulation A (Reg A) and Regulation D (Reg D) securities offerings, including listing, compliance, and distribution, delivered through a licensed broker-dealer subsidiary and leveraging strategic partnerships. Services are provided digitally and require regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consulting and Advisory Services for Fundraising
products.description: Strategic advice, technology consulting, and online marketing services to assist companies with fundraising campaigns, including investor introductions, marketing, website/software development, and message crafting. Delivered by human consultants and digital tools, previously for both cash and equity compensation.

products.name: Ancillary Issuer Services (e.g., Rolling Closes, Regulatory Filings)
products.description: Additional administrative and compliance services for issuers using the funding portal, such as rolling closes, automated regulatory filings, compliance review, and assistance with annual filings. Delivered digitally via the platform and supported by staff as needed.

products.name: Secondary Trading Platform for Private Securities (Proposed/Paused)
products.description: A proposed digital platform for secondary trading of private company securities, leveraging a partnership with an ATS operator to provide liquidity for investors. The service is subject to regulatory approval and was in beta as of July 2024, with development currently paused.

products.name: Milestone and Royalty Revenue Streams
products.description: Acquisition and aggregation of economic rights to future milestone and royalty payments associated with commercial and development-stage pharmaceutical and biotechnology products. These rights are acquired from third parties and generate revenue as the underlying drugs achieve regulatory, commercial, or sales milestones. Delivery is financial and contractual, not physical or digital.

products.name: Out-Licensing and Sale of Unpartnered Assets and Intellectual Property
products.description: Sale or out-licensing of unpartnered drug assets and intellectual property acquired through company acquisitions or portfolio management. These transactions involve transferring rights to develop or commercialize drug candidates or platforms to external parties, typically for upfront payments, milestones, or royalties. Delivery is contractual and involves legal transfer of rights.

products.name: LYR-210 (Bioabsorbable Nasal Implant for Chronic Rhinosinusitis)
products.description: A bioabsorbable nasal implant designed to deliver six months of continuous anti-inflammatory drug therapy locally to the sinonasal passages for the treatment of chronic rhinosinusitis (CRS). Manufactured using a proprietary drug delivery technology involving a mesh scaffold, elastomeric matrix, and polymer-drug complex, and administered in a simple, in-office procedure.

products.name: LYR-220 (Bioabsorbable Nasal Implant for Post-Surgical Chronic Rhinosinusitis)
products.description: A larger-dimension bioabsorbable nasal implant, substantially similar to LYR-210, designed for CRS patients with larger nasal cavities, including those who have undergone ethmoid sinus surgery. It delivers sustained local anti-inflammatory drug therapy over six months using the same proprietary technology platform.

products.name: Racing Video Games
products.description: Development and publishing of racing video games for PCs, including full games and downloadable content (DLC), based on official motorsport series such as the 24 Hours of Le Mans and FIA World Endurance Championship. These are distributed digitally via platforms like Steam and require significant software development and licensing of motorsport brands.

products.name: Racing Simulation Platforms and Technology Licensing
products.description: Provision of advanced racing simulation platforms and technology, such as rFactor 2, which powers third-party experiences (e.g., F1 Arcade) through partnerships. This involves licensing simulation technology to external partners and supporting their racing-related digital experiences.

products.name: Esports Event Organization and Media Rights
products.description: Organization and management of esports competitions and virtual racing events, including the Le Mans Virtual Series, with revenue potential from sponsorships, advertising, and media rights. These events are broadcast across TV and OTT channels and are designed to engage a global motorsport audience.

products.name: Product Development Services for Third Parties
products.description: Provision of software development, support, and maintenance services to third-party clients, leveraging internal expertise in game and simulation development. This includes ongoing support and maintenance of developed software for external customers.

products.name: Funeral Services
products.description: Comprehensive funeral services including arranging and directing services, use of funeral home facilities, preparation, embalming, removal, memorialization, and catering, delivered through a network of funeral service locations and combination funeral/cemetery facilities.

products.name: Cemetery Property Interment Rights
products.description: Sale of cemetery property interment rights such as developed lots, lawn crypts, mausoleum spaces, cremation niches, private mausoleums, and family estates, requiring significant land development and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Cremation Services
products.description: Cremation services including cremation-specific service packages, memorialization, and return of ashes, delivered through funeral homes, crematoria, and combination locations, with options for both at-need and preneed customers.

products.name: Funeral and Cemetery Merchandise
products.description: Merchandise such as burial caskets, urns, outer burial containers, flowers, memorial markers, stationery, and other ancillary products, sold at funeral service locations and cemeteries as part of funeral and burial arrangements.

products.name: Preneed Funeral and Cemetery Contracts
products.description: Advance sale of funeral and cemetery services and merchandise through preneed contracts, allowing customers to prearrange and prepay for future services, supported by a dedicated sales force and digital channels.

products.name: Refined Petroleum Products
products.description: Production and wholesale marketing of refined petroleum products including gasoline, distillates (diesel, jet fuel, kerosene), heavy fuel oil, asphalt, propane, NGLs, and petrochemicals. Products are manufactured at company-owned refineries and distributed via pipelines, terminals, trucks, railcars, ships, and barges to wholesale, branded, and export customers.

products.name: Midstream Energy Logistics and Services
products.description: Gathering, transportation, storage, and distribution services for crude oil, refined products, natural gas, and NGLs, primarily through pipelines, terminals, towboats, barges, and storage assets. Services are provided to both internal and external customers, including fuels distribution and NGL fractionation.

products.name: Renewable Diesel
products.description: Production, marketing, and distribution of renewable diesel manufactured from renewable feedstocks (corn oil, soybean oil, fats, greases) at wholly owned and joint venture facilities. Renewable diesel is sold to wholesale, spot, and retail customers, generating regulatory credits and meeting compliance obligations.

products.name: Natural Gas and NGL Marketing
products.description: Gathering, processing, fractionation, storage, and marketing of natural gas and natural gas liquids (NGLs) to domestic and international customers. Operations include natural gas gathering systems, processing plants, and NGL fractionation complexes.

products.name: Asphalt Products
products.description: Manufacture and wholesale distribution of asphalt products including asphalt cements, polymer-modified asphalt, emulsified asphalt, industrial asphalts, and roofing flux. Products are sold to paving contractors, resellers, government entities, and roofing manufacturers.

products.name: Propane Sales
products.description: Production and sale of propane, primarily for home heating, cooking, industrial, and petrochemical uses. Propane is produced at all refineries and marketed to both residential and industrial customers.

products.name: Petroleum Coke Products
products.description: Production and sale of fuel-grade and anode-grade petroleum coke, used for power generation, industrial applications, and aluminum smelting. Produced at select refineries and marketed to industrial customers.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG)
products.description: Production and marketing of renewable natural gas (RNG) from dairy farm-based, low carbon intensity projects through joint ventures. RNG is sold into energy markets for transportation and compliance purposes.

products.name: Lasofoxifene
products.description: A novel, orally bioavailable, small molecule selective estrogen receptor modulator (SERM) developed for the treatment of ESR1-mutated metastatic breast cancer. Manufactured using established small molecule synthesis and formulated into tablets for oral administration, pending regulatory approval for commercial sale.

products.name: ATH-1105
products.description: A novel, orally available, brain-penetrant, small molecule drug candidate designed to positively modulate the neurotrophic HGF system for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and potentially other neurodegenerative diseases. Produced via small molecule synthesis and formulated for oral administration, currently in clinical development.

products.name: ATH-1020 and Early HGF System Modulators
products.description: A pipeline of proprietary, orally available small molecule drug candidates (including ATH-1020 and other early-stage compounds) designed to positively modulate the neurotrophic HGF system for neurological diseases such as neuropathic pain and other indications. These are produced via small molecule synthesis and are in preclinical or early clinical development.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of one- to four-family residential first mortgage loans, including both fixed-rate and adjustable-rate mortgages, primarily in Lake County, Illinois and surrounding areas. Loans are originated through branch offices and loan production offices, with some sold into the secondary mortgage market. This business requires regulated underwriting, in-person and online application processing, and compliance with federal mortgage standards.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of mortgage loans secured by commercial real estate properties, including investor properties and retail frontage, in the local market area. These loans are underwritten with conservative standards, often require personal guarantees, and are subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Multi-Family Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of mortgage loans secured by multi-family residential properties (more than four units or multiple one- to four-family properties), primarily in the local market area. These loans are underwritten similarly to commercial real estate loans and require property and borrower evaluation.

products.name: Residential Construction Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for the construction and rehabilitation of one- to four-family residential properties, including land loans for properties zoned for residential construction. These loans are typically short-term and convert to conventional mortgages upon project completion.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans, including loans secured by deposits, auto loans, and unsecured personal loans, to retail customers. These loans are typically smaller, have higher interest rates and shorter terms than residential loans, and are offered to complement the bank's full range of financial services.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a variety of deposit accounts to retail and business customers, including checking (interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing), savings, money market, and time deposit (certificate of deposit) accounts. These services are delivered through physical branches and online banking platforms, and are a primary source of funding for lending activities.

products.name: Online Banking Services
products.description: Provision of digital banking services, allowing customers to access accounts, submit loan applications, and conduct transactions online. This service is delivered through the bank's website and digital platforms, complementing traditional branch-based services.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Loan Investments
products.description: Investment in a diversified portfolio of residential mortgage loans, including reperforming loans, business purpose loans (RTLs), investor loans, jumbo prime loans, Non-QM loans, and junior lien loans, primarily acquired through secondary market purchases or retained from origination. These are financed via securitization, warehouse facilities, and repurchase agreements.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Loan Origination and Sale
products.description: Origination and sale of consumer Non-QM, investor business purpose, and agency-conforming residential mortgage loans through the HomeXpress subsidiary, primarily via a wholesale network of mortgage brokers and bankers. Loans are funded by warehouse facilities and sold to institutional investors.

products.name: Agency Mortgage-Backed Securities (Agency RMBS and CMBS) Investments
products.description: Investment in mortgage-backed securities (RMBS) and commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) issued or guaranteed by government agencies such as Ginnie Mae, Fannie Mae, or Freddie Mac. These are liquid, regulated securities representing interests in pools of residential or multifamily mortgage loans.

products.name: Non-Agency Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities (RMBS) Investments
products.description: Investment in non-agency RMBS, including investment grade, non-investment grade, and non-rated certificates created by securitizing pools of residential mortgage loans not guaranteed by government agencies. These are analyzed for credit risk and cash flow characteristics.

products.name: Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSRs) Investments
products.description: Investment in mortgage servicing rights, either as excess servicing rights or the entire MSR, which entitle the holder to a portion of the interest payments on a pool of residential mortgage loans in exchange for servicing them. These may be acquired for portfolio diversification and interest rate risk hedging.

products.name: Third-Party Investment Management and Advisory Services
products.description: Provision of non-discretionary and discretionary investment management and advisory services to institutional clients, primarily related to residential real estate assets. Income is generated from management and advisory fees.

products.name: Commercial Mortgage Loan and CMBS Investments
products.description: Investment in commercial mortgage loans secured by multifamily, mixed-use, retail, office, or industrial properties, and in non-agency commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS). These investments are made for portfolio diversification and potential risk-adjusted returns.

products.name: Other Real Estate-Related Asset Investments
products.description: Investment in a variety of other real estate-related assets, including junior lien loans, home equity lines of credit (HELOCs), home equity option or shared appreciation contracts, reverse mortgage loans, single-family rental properties, credit risk transfer securities, home improvement loans, and manufactured housing loans. These are ancillary to the core business.

products.name: Power Management Solutions
products.description: Vertiv designs, manufactures, and sells AC and DC power management products, including low/medium voltage switchgear, busbar, single phase UPS, rack power distribution, and energy storage solutions. These are physical products requiring advanced engineering and manufacturing, delivered to support critical digital infrastructure.

products.name: Thermal Management Solutions
products.description: Vertiv manufactures and sells air-cooled and liquid-cooled thermal management products and rack thermal systems, which are engineered to maintain optimal temperatures for data centers and other critical environments. These are physical systems requiring specialized manufacturing and installation.

products.name: Integrated Modular Solutions and Racks
products.description: Vertiv provides integrated modular solutions and racks, including configurable integrated solutions, which are pre-engineered, rapidly deployable physical infrastructure systems for data centers and other critical environments. These require manufacturing, engineering, and on-site installation.

products.name: IT Infrastructure Management Software and Hardware
products.description: Vertiv develops and sells software and hardware for managing IT equipment, including IT management software and KVM (keyboard, video, mouse) solutions. These are digital and physical products enabling remote and local management of IT infrastructure.

products.name: Lifecycle Management and Professional Services
products.description: Vertiv offers a comprehensive suite of services including installation, preventative maintenance, project management, acceptance testing, engineering and consulting, performance assessments, remote monitoring, specialized fluid management, training, and spare parts. These services are delivered by a global network of field engineers and specialists, supporting the full lifecycle of critical digital infrastructure.

products.name: Electric Vertical Take-Off and Landing Vehicles (eVTOLs)
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft optimized for urban air mobility missions. These vehicles are physically manufactured in modular production facilities and delivered to operators globally, requiring regulatory certification and advanced engineering.

products.name: eVTOL Maintenance and Support Services (TechCare)
products.description: A portfolio of aftermarket services for eVTOLs, including material services, maintenance, technical support, training, ground handling, and data services. These services are delivered both for Eve's own and third-party eVTOLs, leveraging a global support network and requiring in-person technical labor and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Urban Air Traffic Management System (Vector)
products.description: Development and sale of a next-generation Urban Air Traffic Management (UATM) software platform, enabling safe and efficient operation of eVTOLs and other aircraft in dense urban airspace. This is a digital-only product delivered primarily to air navigation service providers, fleet operators, and vertiport operators.

products.name: Industrial Gases
products.description: Production and supply of atmospheric gases (oxygen, nitrogen, argon, rare gases) and process gases (hydrogen, helium, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, specialty gases, acetylene) through various manufacturing processes and distributed via on-site, merchant, and packaged methods. Requires large-scale physical manufacturing, regulated infrastructure, and logistics.

products.name: Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) of Gas Production Plants
products.description: Design, engineering, and construction of plants for the production and processing of industrial gases, including air separation, hydrogen, synthesis gas, olefin, and natural gas plants. Delivered as large-scale capital projects requiring advanced process engineering and sustainable technologies.

products.name: Gas Production and Processing Services
products.description: Provision of services related to the operation, optimization, and maintenance of gas production and processing facilities, including on-site plant management, digital solutions for plant efficiency, and carbon management solutions. Delivered through technical expertise and digital platforms.

products.name: Salt Products
products.description: Production and sale of salt (primarily sodium chloride) and magnesium chloride products, including rock salt, mechanically-evaporated salt, solar-evaporated salt, brine magnesium chloride, and flake magnesium chloride, for highway deicing, water conditioning, food processing, agricultural, chemical, and various industrial and consumer applications. Products are manufactured through mining, mechanical and solar evaporation, and blending, and distributed via an extensive depot network.

products.name: Sulfate of Potash (SOP) Plant Nutrition Products
products.description: Production and sale of specialty sulfate of potash (SOP) fertilizers, marketed under the Protassium+ brand, in various grades for use in agriculture, turf, and organic cropping systems. SOP is produced at a solar evaporation facility and sold to distributors, retailers, and growers for crop yield improvement and sustainable agriculture.

products.name: Records Management Services
products.description: Provision of secure underground document and archive storage services in the UK, utilizing excavated areas of the Winsford salt mine and a warehouse in London. This service is delivered through the DeepStore business and involves physical storage infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial and Multi-family Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate and multi-family properties, including office buildings, retail stores, shopping centers, warehouses, and apartment buildings. These loans are physically underwritten, require property appraisals, and are delivered through in-person banking relationships.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by one-to-four family dwellings, condominiums, and cooperative units, including both fixed and adjustable-rate mortgages. These are physically underwritten, require property appraisals, and are delivered through branch and correspondent relationships.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending
products.description: Provision of commercial business loans, including lines of credit and term loans, to small and mid-sized companies for working capital, equipment purchases, or business acquisition. These loans are underwritten based on business cash flow and collateral, and require in-person relationship management.

products.name: Construction Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to finance the construction of commercial and residential properties, with funds disbursed as projects progress. These loans are physically underwritten, require third-party reviews and appraisals, and are delivered through direct relationships with developers and builders.

products.name: Home Equity Loans and Lines of Credit
products.description: Provision of home equity loans and lines of credit secured by residential or investment properties, offered as lump-sum loans or revolving credit lines. These are underwritten similarly to residential mortgages and delivered through branch banking.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of secured and unsecured consumer loans, including passbook and automobile loans, typically with fixed rates and short terms. These are physically underwritten and delivered through branch banking.

products.name: SBA Lending
products.description: Origination of business loans guaranteed by the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA), including SBA 7(a) loans, to qualifying small businesses. These loans are underwritten to SBA standards and may be sold in the secondary market.

products.name: Cannabis-related Lending
products.description: Provision of commercial, construction, and business loans to borrowers involved in the cannabis industry, underwritten with additional risk controls. These loans are delivered through direct relationships and require specialized compliance.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Offering of FDIC-insured deposit accounts to consumers and businesses, including savings, club accounts, demand accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, and individual retirement accounts. These are delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital channels.

products.name: Retail and Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Provision of banking services such as wire transfers, money orders, safe deposit boxes, night depository, debit cards, online banking, mobile banking, fraud detection, and ATM services to retail and business customers. These services are delivered through branches, digital platforms, and ATMs.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales
products.description: Investment in and management of securities portfolios, including U.S. Treasury obligations, federal agency securities, mortgage-backed securities, municipal obligations, equity securities, certificates of deposit, and corporate debt. These are managed for the bank’s own account and as part of liquidity management, not as a retail brokerage for customers.

products.name: YUTREPIA (treprostinil) Inhalation Powder
products.description: An inhaled dry-powder formulation of treprostinil for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD), manufactured using proprietary PRINT technology and delivered via a dry-powder inhaler. Commercialized following FDA approval in May 2025.

products.name: Treprostinil Injection (Generic Remodulin)
products.description: A fully-substitutable generic treprostinil for parenteral (intravenous and subcutaneous) administration to treat PAH, commercialized in partnership with Sandoz. Manufactured and supplied in multi-dose vials for use with infusion pumps, distributed through specialty pharmacies.

products.name: L606 (Liposomal Treprostinil Inhalation)
products.description: An investigational, inhaled, sustained-release liposomal formulation of treprostinil for PAH and PH-ILD, administered via next-generation nebulizer. Licensed from Pharmosa and currently in clinical development, with manufacturing by contract organizations.

products.name: Enobosarm (Selective Androgen Receptor Modulator)
products.description: An orally administered, novel selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed for the treatment of obesity, specifically to preserve muscle and physical function, augment fat loss, and cause greater weight loss in patients receiving GLP-1 receptor agonists. Manufactured as a modified release oral formulation, it is delivered through clinical and, if approved, commercial pharmaceutical channels.

products.name: Sabizabulin (Oral Microtubule Disruptor)
products.description: A novel, orally administered small molecule that disrupts microtubules, developed as a broad anti-inflammatory agent to reduce inflammation and slow the progression or promote regression of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. Manufactured as an oral pharmaceutical product, it is intended for use in combination with statin therapy for patients with coronary artery disease.

products.name: Small Molecule Therapeutics for Neurodegenerative and Lysosomal Storage Disorders
products.description: Orally administered, proprietary small molecule drugs designed to modulate protein function by binding to allosteric sites, produced using computational drug discovery and preclinical/clinical development, targeting diseases such as Parkinson’s disease, Gaucher disease, dementia with Lewy bodies, and Alzheimer’s disease.

products.name: Magellan™ Computational Drug Discovery Platform (Licensing and Collaboration)
products.description: A proprietary, AI-driven computational platform for discovering novel allosteric binding sites and identifying small molecule drug candidates, offered for use in academic partnerships, co-development, and licensing arrangements with external partners.

products.name: Stenoparib (PARP/Tankyrase Inhibitor) Therapeutics
products.description: A novel, dual inhibitor of PARP1/2 and tankyrases, developed as an oral anti-cancer therapeutic for advanced, recurrent ovarian cancer and other cancers. Manufactured via pharmaceutical processes and delivered as an oral drug, with clinical trials focused on patient populations selected by companion diagnostics.

products.name: DRP® Companion Diagnostic Platform
products.description: A proprietary bioinformatic platform that develops drug-specific gene expression-based companion diagnostics to predict cancer patient response to specific anti-cancer therapeutics. Delivered as a laboratory and data analysis service, involving gene expression profiling of tumor biopsies and advanced algorithmic analysis.

products.name: DRP® Analysis and Gene Expression Services
products.description: Laboratory-based services provided to external biotech clients, including gene expression profiling and DRP® analysis for research or diagnostic purposes. These services leverage the company's laboratory and bioinformatic capabilities and are delivered as fee-for-service laboratory and data analysis offerings.

products.name: Out-Licensing of DRP® Companion Diagnostics
products.description: Licensing of proprietary DRP® companion diagnostics to external partners for use with their own cancer therapeutic development programs. This is a business-to-business licensing model, providing access to DRP® technology and intellectual property for external drug development.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate, including owner-occupied, non-owner-occupied, multifamily, residential developments, and construction loans. Requires regulated financial capital, underwriting, and ongoing loan servicing.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to businesses secured by business assets such as inventory, receivables, and equipment, including asset-based lending, accounts receivable financing, equipment financing, floorplan financing, and SBA lending. Delivered through in-person financial expertise and regulated lending infrastructure.

products.name: Asset-Based Lending
products.description: Revolving lines of credit and term loans to businesses, secured by assets, for acquisitions, capital expenditures, working capital, and restructuring. Requires specialized underwriting and is delivered nationwide.

products.name: Accounts Receivable Financing
products.description: Purchase of accounts receivable from clients on a recourse or non-recourse basis to provide working capital. Delivered nationwide and involves ongoing monitoring and collection services.

products.name: Equipment Financing
products.description: Loans and leases for a broad range of commercial equipment, including manufacturing, medical, agriculture, and construction equipment, delivered via direct and vendor channels with proprietary digital application tools.

products.name: Floorplan Financing
products.description: Short-term loans to independent car dealerships to finance vehicle inventory, typically structured as revolving lines of credit. Delivered nationwide with specialized underwriting.

products.name: SBA Lending and Servicing
products.description: Origination, packaging, underwriting, servicing, and liquidation of Small Business Administration (SBA) loans under various federal programs, leveraging delegated authority as a Preferred Lender. Delivered nationwide and includes gain-on-sale activities.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive cash and liquidity management solutions for business clients, including deposit accounts, payment processing, fraud protection, information reporting, and international payment services. Delivered via digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Company Retirement Plan Services
products.description: Fiduciary and investment management services for corporate retirement plans, including asset allocation, discretionary trustee services, and administration of non-proprietary funds. Requires regulated investment expertise and ongoing plan management.

products.name: Private Wealth Management
products.description: Fiduciary and investment management for individuals, including trust and estate administration, financial planning, investment management, and private banking. Delivered through regulated advisory and custodial services.

products.name: Private Banking
products.description: Customized banking services, including loans and deposit products, for high net worth individuals as part of the private wealth offering. Delivered through relationship managers and specialized underwriting.

products.name: Bank Consulting Services
